NFL.lesson: When the model picks a different winner than the Vegas favorite, it has mostly lost so far.
NFL.evidence: 1 of 5 graded games where the model's side was not the Vegas favorite won (CIN over BAL won; NYG over NO, ATL over CHI, PHI over CAR, NE over CHI lost). PHI over DAL on Monday would be a sixth, but it appears to use Hurts, who is on IR.
NFL.test: On past seasons, take every game where the model's pick differs from the moneyline favorite. Compare its win rate and spread record with Vegas. Wait for 20+ games.

NFL.lesson: Large gaps between the model's total and Vegas's total have not paid off, but smaller gaps have.
NFL.evidence: 0 of 4 graded games with a gap of 4.9 points or more (CHI 6.6, CAR 5.2, NE-CHI 5.0, BAL 4.9) won the over/under pick. Overall over/under is now 13-13, so the other 22 games went 13-9.
NFL.test: On past seasons, group games by size of the total gap (under 2, 2-4, over 4). Check hit rate per group. Needs 20+ games in the large-gap group.

NFL.lesson: Many big misses come from efficiency swings, which the model can't see before kickoff.
NFL.evidence: In 6 of the 12 games where the winner was wrong, the review names efficiency as the main reason (TB-CAR, NYG-HOU, ARI-LA, CHI-ATL, CAR-PHI, BAL-CLE). Turnovers led in NO-NYG and SF-ATL, HOU-JAX had no clear reason, and MIA-NYJ and NE-CHI were close.
NFL.test: On past seasons, measure how often big spread misses (over 8 points) are driven by efficiency versus turnovers. Check whether the model's misses are larger than Vegas's overall.

NFL.lesson: Big-game player picks hit less often than the model's chances say, but the gap has narrowed.
NFL.evidence: 5 of 17 big-game picks hit, against 5.6 expected, at -6.63 units. Earlier it was 1 of 9 against 3.0. Milestone picks are 12 of 17 against 12.7 expected.
NFL.test: On past seasons, compare predicted chance with actual hit rate for 300+ yard and similar long-shot props, in buckets of model chance. Needs 20+ picks.

NFL.lesson: Best-value picks against the sportsbook were underperforming, but have recovered somewhat.
NFL.evidence: 5 of 11 best-value picks hit this season, against 5.8 expected, at -1.45 units. It was 2 of 7 last week.
NFL.test: On past seasons, check hit rate of the model's top value picks by size of edge. Needs 20+ picks.

NFL.lesson: The model's margin errors are larger than Vegas's, and it is below .500 against the spread.
NFL.evidence: Average spread miss is 9.7 for the model against 8.4 for Vegas over 26 graded games. The model is 9-16-1 against the spread. Week 7 alone was 6-6-1.
NFL.test: On past seasons, compare the model's average absolute margin error with Vegas's, by week, over a full season. Also check ATS record by season. Do this before changing anything.

NFL.lesson: Big gaps between the model and Vegas may come from lineup changes the model hasn't picked up.
NFL.evidence: 1 clear case so far: DAL at PHI lists Hurts, who is on IR with McKee starting, and the model is PHI by 3.9 against Vegas DAL -4.5, an 8.4-point gap. Possible second case: TB lists Daniels, but Mayfield's status was open; TB won 43-13 against the model's CAR pick. Far under 20 games.
NFL.test: On past seasons, flag games where a starting QB differed from the one in the model's inputs. Compare the model's margin error in those games with all others. Needs 20+ such games.

College.lesson: The 'model total 3+ above Vegas means the over hits' pattern may not hold up.
College.evidence: By my count in the Week 7-8 results listed, the over hit in 8 of 13 games where the model total was 3+ above Vegas (Week 7: 6 of 10; Week 8: 2 of 3). That is only slightly better than a coin flip, and the sample is under 20. No new games this run.
College.test: On past seasons, group games by model total minus Vegas total (0-3, 3-6, 6+) and check how often the over hits in each group. Need 20+ games per group.

College.lesson: Big misses mostly show up as efficiency gaps; turnovers and finishing drives come second.
College.evidence: Earlier set: efficiency was the top reason in 17 of 24 games missed by 8+. In the Week 7 list, 12 of 17 such games name efficiency first, 3 turnovers, 2 finishing drives. Efficiency is measured after the game, so it partly restates the miss. Week 8 results have no reviews.
College.test: On past seasons, check whether a team's success rate in prior games predicts the model's error next game. Also compare turnover margin and points per trip inside the 40 with the long-run average, to see if misses lean one way or are random.

College.lesson: When the model picks a different favorite than Vegas, early results are mixed, not bad.
College.evidence: 6 games with a different favorite: the model was right in 3 (Missouri State, Army, Marshall) and wrong in 3 (Cincinnati, Old Dominion, Rice over Tulsa). No new games this run. Sample is tiny.
College.test: On past seasons, list games where the model and Vegas disagree on the winner, then compare the model's win rate with Vegas's. Need 20+ games.

College.lesson: When the model has the favorite winning by 3+ more points than Vegas, the favorite has mostly not covered.
College.evidence: In the Week 7-8 results listed, 9 games fit (Utah, Fresno State, Houston, UCLA, NC State, Air Force, UConn, James Madison, Florida International). The favorite covered in 2 (UCLA over Wisconsin, UConn) and failed in 7. Today's BYU (gap 8.4), Troy (6.8), Ohio (9.0) and Kentucky (4.4) fit.
College.test: On past seasons, take games where the model's favorite margin is 3+ points above Vegas's and check the cover rate by size of gap (3-6, 6+). Need 20+ games per group.

College.lesson: The 'Best value against the sportsbook' list has been weak so far.
College.evidence: This season the list is 2 of 7 against 3.6 expected, at -3.18 units. Seven games is far too few to read, and the edges are thin (about 51% against 52.4% needed).
College.test: On past seasons, bucket the model's spread and total picks by edge size and compare hit rates with the 52.4% break-even. Need 20+ games per bucket.

College.lesson: Underdog picks have beaten the model's own chances so far.
College.evidence: 3 of 5 underdog picks hit, against 1.9 expected, at +4.59 units. Five picks is far too few to read.
College.test: On past seasons, compare predicted chance with actual win rate for the model's underdog picks, in buckets of model chance (under 35%, 35-45%). Needs 20+ picks.
